clips.title: The story
paras: Coleman Farthing, a former mill worker now dwelling in Brill, seeks personal vengeance against the aristocratic Agamand family. Convinced to stay and defend their estates against the Scourge during the Third War, Farthing and his fellow workers perished alongside their stubborn employers, only for the Agamands to rise as mindless thralls of the Lich King.

Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, the Agamand family stood as the wealthiest and most influential agrarian dynasty in Tirisfal Glades. Their sprawling mills and fertile pastures produced bountiful grain, commanding the labor of dozens of tenant farmers and millers. When the Plague of Undeath crept across the kingdom, the Agamands refused to flee or abandon their ancestral holdings, convinced that stone walls and loyal workers could hold off the horrors advancing from the east.

Believing their lords' assurances, loyal employees like Coleman Farthing stood their ground to defend the estate. The defense proved futile against the Scourge's relentless onslaught. The Agamands and their workers were slaughtered, their bodies rotting where they fell before being raised into undeath. While Farthing eventually broke free through Sylvanas Windrunner's liberation, the Agamand patriarchs and heirs remained trapped under the Lich King's mental grip, wandering the ruined mills as mindless Scourge sentries.

Now residing in Brill, Coleman Farthing harbors intense resentment toward the former masters whose arrogance cost him his mortal life. Seeking closure and retribution, he sends Forsaken champions to Agamand Mills to destroy Gregor, Nissa, and Thurman Agamand. Farthing openly hopes that behind their rotting visages, his former masters retained just enough consciousness to feel terror as their unlife was violently brought to an end.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades. I used to work their mills...before the Plague.
When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.
The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. And now they are minions of the Scourge!
Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague. Serve me by bringing me their remains.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the remains of the Agamands? Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.
It is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
